title: Mr. Finn's Catch

readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: Hello there! The nets came in full this morning. Each family in the village has ordered some fish.

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: Put the right number in each basket: the number's on the label.

steps.speaker: finn
steps.prompt: Put that many fish in each basket: the number on the label.
steps.hint: Count the fish as you put them in.

older.prompt: Read the number on each basket and count that many fish in.

feedback.full: That basket has its {n}. Try another.

outro.speaker: finn
outro.text: And the little ones go back in the lake, to grow. We take only what we need.

journal_line: I helped Mr. Finn put fish in the baskets for the families.
unavailable_text: The fish are packed for today.
